name: just_me_again_down_here
description: Just Me Again Down Here was created a few weeks after my family and I moved to China, using a Wacom Tablet and Adobe Illustrator. This is my “messy” handwriting with mixed capitals and irregularities. After moving to China and finding myself without the ability to communicate in my new home country’s language, creating a font was something that reminded me that I did know how to do something and I would survive those first confusing weeks abroad.
